fixes: Server now accepts fieldKey/comparison as well as field/operator.
Unknown server filter fields cause an explicit error instead of silently returning unfiltered documents.
Incomplete base lists no longer produce partial filter previews.
Server filter pages are collected before one render; only complete filter results are reusable from cache.
multi_page_regression: Two mocked pages publish no intermediate result and render exactly once after the last page.
scope: One real customer equality filter plus mocked multi-page coverage; timing is a sample, not a guarantee for all filter types.
